## Documented professional background
- Investor-facing financial analysis and capital markets initiatives at IAG.
- Coordinates acquisition assessments in Vietnam involving publicly traded companies and agricultural processing businesses.
- Supports preliminary valuation, financial due diligence, transaction planning, liaison with securities firms, banks and external advisers.
- Supports establishment of IAG Vietnam financial operations through accounting, treasury coordination, financial reporting, tax/regulatory compliance and controls.
- Experience before IAG: SSI Securities and Nam A Commercial Bank.
- Completed nine ACCA Applied Knowledge and Applied Skills examinations; not an assertion of ACCA membership.
- No closed transactions, funding totals or financial results claimed.
